description: Removal of existing cladding & brickwork system and installing new insulation to the resistance to fire with an A1 fire rated external rainscreen cladding & brick slip system. Removal and replacement of existing windows, spandrel panels & AOVAC. Removal of existing combustible roof systems and replaced with a minimum of BroofT4 to improve the resistance to fire.
